searchText: I'm investigating how many precompiles you can implement with OpenSSL. 1. I did priv key → address. Maybe ecrecover is possible too. 2. Can you do expmod? 3. Can you do the set of BN curve precompiles (up to pairing)?

excerpts.author: chfast
excerpts.content:
I'm investigating how many precompiles you can implement with OpenSSL.
1. I did priv key → address. Maybe ecrecover is possible too.
2. Can you do expmod?
3. Can you do the set of BN curve precompiles (up to pairing)?
